request.spec:
Each user has a locale (a select on the screen, en unless chosen, saved per user, no audit line).
Under de, every figure the screen shows that user (amounts, due figures, totals, rates, shares,
cuts: any cell whose whole text is a number with two decimals) is shown as 1.234,56 (a dot every
three digits, a comma before the decimals); under en as before. Entries are typed with a dot as
before, and exports and audit lines are unchanged.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Each user has a locale (a select on the screen, en unless chosen, saved per user, no audit line).
Under de, every figure the screen shows that user (amounts, due figures, totals, rates, shares,
cuts: any cell whose whole text is a number with two decimals) is shown as 1.234,56 (a dot every
three digits, a comma before the decimals); under en as before. Entries are typed with a dot as
before, and exports and audit lines are unchanged.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Each user now has a locale, and under `de` the screen shows figures as `1.234,56`. All 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

**Server**
- A new table `user_locale` (migration `V88__user_locale.sql`) stores one locale per user name, shared across all sheets.
- Signing in now also returns the user's locale, `en` if they never chose one.
- `PUT /api/session/locale` saves a choice. It accepts only `en` or `de` and writes no audit line.

**Front end**
- Under the "Signed in as" line there's a locale select (`user-locale`), a Save button (`user-locale-save`), the saved value (`user-locale-current`) and an error element (`user-locale-error`).
- A new `figure` pipe (`core/figure.ts`) changes a value only when its whole text is a number with two decimals (`-?\d+\.\d{2}`). Counts, `n/a`, blanks and other text pass through unchanged.
- I applied the pipe to the 54 figure cells: amounts, due figures, totals, rates, shares, cuts, period figures and the current-value readouts of the money settings.
- Typed entries, CSV exports and audit lines are unchanged. The first test checks this: Uma sees `de` figures, Vic still sees `en` ones on the same sheet, and the export stays in dot format.

**One change outside the request:** scenario 2 failed even with the locale work in place, on a step that has nothing to do with locale. A viewer pressing "Generate planned claims" got an error, but the test expects "Made 0". The plan-generate endpoint now works like the existing bulk actions: a viewer's generate, or one on an archived sheet, goes through and makes nothing (`ClaimPlanController`, `ClaimPlanService`). Without this, scenario 2 cannot pass, but it is a behaviour change in its own right.

**Limitation:** while a `de` user has the screen, the setting readouts (e.g. "Floor now") also show `de` format. The `setSetting` test helper may compare those against the dot-form value it typed, so setting a value while in `de` might not read back as a match. None of the tests do this.
